sentences.en: Please do not forget capital letters and punctuation! Thank you!
sentences.zh: 请不要忘记大写字母和标点符号！谢谢！

sentences.en: Emojis have gone beyond just punctuation marks, letters and numbers.
sentences.zh: 表情符号已经超越了仅仅作为标点符号、字母和数字的存在。

sentences.en: The rules of punctuation change from one language to another.
sentences.zh: 不同语言的标点规则各不相同。

senses.zh: 标点法,标点符号,标点符号的使用,点标点
